cases.estimand: For each focal trial, comparisons to same-condition and different-condition trials under an explicit participant and identity relation.
cases.independent_case: Exhaustive Cartesian pair enumeration detects reference join, self-edge and denominator defects.
cases.divergence: Seven supplied-map method means agree with independent Cartesian/rational and pinned pairwise true/false evidence. Reference condition groups cross participant/stimulus; native reinstatement has explicit relations and excludes ambiguous full keys. Typed two-stage scale/comparison means retain every failure and denominator; partial-success policy matches nested reference means, strict policy intentionally refuses omissions. EMD retains prior intentional unavailable/backend qualification, including multiscale errors. Separate all-occasion supplied-map schema reconstructs typed projection registrations, disjoint finite relations, exact BottomK selections, keys, counts, identities and provenance across three occasions on JVM/JS. Old two-phase study v1 stays readable. Multiscale aggregation is explicit outside the single-map persisted recipe.
